project.title: Quarter-End Close and Tax Compliance Process Upgrade
project.objective: Standardise and speed up quarter-end closing while ensuring full tax and statutory compliance across all ledgers.
deliverables: Documented quarter-end closing checklist and calendar
Standard templates for journal entries and supporting documents
Updated tax calculation and depreciation schedules
Consolidated quarter-end financial statements draft package
Compliance review report with remediation actions
Playbook for roles and responsibilities in the close process
constraints: Quarter-end close must be completed within 7 business days
All outputs must comply with applicable tax legislation and accounting conventions
No changes to core accounting system configuration during the quarter
Limited availability of external tax advisor for only 4 review slots
All supporting documents must be auditable and traceable to source transactions

risks.risk: Delays in collecting supporting documents from departments extend close timeline.
risks.mitigation: Introduce pre-close reminders, clear deadlines, and escalation path for late submissions.

risks.risk: Incorrect tax calculations due to last-minute adjustments.
risks.mitigation: Lock cut-off for adjustments, run tax calculation review checklist, and involve financial manager for high-impact items.

risks.risk: Inconsistent application of depreciation and accounting policies across ledgers.
risks.mitigation: Create standard policy summary, central depreciation schedule, and spot checks by financial manager.

risks.risk: Audit findings due to missing or misfiled accounting certificates.
risks.mitigation: Implement mandatory attachment checklist and random file audits before sign-off.

risks.risk: Team overload during close leads to errors in accounting entries.
risks.mitigation: Distribute workload via task calendar, enforce peer review on key entries, and use short daily check-ins.

themes.why_relevant: Needed to finish quarter-end close within the 7-day target without overloading the team.
Participants handle tax returns and must ensure all filings and calculations meet legislation.
Common templates reduce errors in journal entries and improve auditability.
Attaching correct certificates is critical for audits and statutory obligations.
Team prepares and interprets financial statements that drive management decisions.
External stakeholders must review key items within limited time windows.

backlog.task: Design detailed quarter-end close checklist and calendar
definition_of_done: Checklist covers all key close activities by day and owner
Calendar approved by financial manager and shared with team
Dependencies on external stakeholders clearly marked

backlog.task: Create standard journal entry templates for recurring transactions
definition_of_done: Templates for payroll, depreciation, accruals, and provisions created
Each template includes required fields and description examples
Templates reviewed and validated by financial manager

backlog.task: Update tax calculation workbook for current quarter rules
definition_of_done: Tax rates and thresholds updated per latest legislation
Sample calculations tested against prior quarter
Workbook structure locked and version-controlled

backlog.task: Compile central depreciation schedule for all fixed assets
definition_of_done: All active assets listed with cost, life, and method
Quarterly depreciation calculated and reconciled to GL
Schedule reviewed and signed off by financial manager

backlog.task: Define documentation standards for accounting certificates and attachments
definition_of_done: List of required supporting documents by transaction type created
Naming and storage conventions documented
Standards communicated to accounting and relevant departments

backlog.task: Prepare draft quarter-end financial statements package
definition_of_done: Draft balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow prepared
Key variances vs prior quarter explained
Package ready for review by external auditor

backlog.task: Implement peer review process for high-risk accounting entries
definition_of_done: Criteria for high-risk entries defined
Peer review checklist created and tested on sample entries
Evidence of review stored with journal entry documentation

backlog.task: Coordinate with tax advisor on complex tax positions
definition_of_done: List of complex items prepared with supporting data
Meeting notes with tax advisor documented
Agreed treatments reflected in tax calculation workbook

backlog.task: Run pre-close training session on new close process
definition_of_done: Training agenda and materials prepared
All bookkeepers attend or review recording
Q&A and action items captured and shared

backlog.task: Perform trial run of new close checklist on prior month data
definition_of_done: Checklist executed on prior month with timings recorded
Issues and bottlenecks logged
Improvement suggestions fed back into checklist

backlog.task: Create close process playbook with roles and responsibilities
definition_of_done: RACI for each close activity documented
Escalation paths and cut-off rules defined
Playbook stored in shared location and linked in channel

backlog.task: Prepare compliance review report for quarter-end close
definition_of_done: Checklist completion and exceptions summarised
Any non-compliance items documented with remediation plan
Report reviewed by financial manager

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, close calendar, and responsibilities for the upgraded process.
threads_plan.trigger: financial manager shares initial draft of the close checklist and calendar.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the quarter-end close calendar and 7-day completion target.
Confirm roles and responsibilities for each major close activity.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define standards for journal entries and supporting documentation.
threads_plan.trigger: bookkeeper posts proposal for journal entry templates and documentation rules.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on the standard journal entry templates to use from next close.
Approve documentation and attachment standards for all entries.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Validate tax and depreciation schedules and align with tax advisor.
threads_plan.trigger: financial manager uploads updated tax workbook and asks for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the updated tax calculation workbook for this quarter.
Confirm depreciation schedule is final and ready to post.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run and debrief the trial close using the new checklist.
threads_plan.trigger: bookkeeper shares results and timing from the trial run on prior month data.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Decide on adjustments to the checklist based on trial close feedback.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Prepare final quarter-end package and confirm readiness for auditors.
threads_plan.trigger: financial manager posts draft financial statements package for final checks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the draft financial statements package for submission to auditors.

channel_rituals: Daily 10-minute async check-in during close week with yesterday/today/risks updates.
Weekly planning post every Monday to review upcoming close-related tasks and owners.
Post-close retrospective thread to capture what worked, issues, and process tweaks.
Pre-close readiness checklist review two days before quarter-end.
Audit and tax Q&A thread kept open during review periods for clarifications.
